analysis: In the parasympathetic nervous system, the preganglionic neurons originate from the brainstem and sacral spinal cord, not the thoracic spinal cord, which is characteristic of the sympathetic nervous system (thus, option opa is incorrect). Postganglionic neurons in the parasympathetic system typically have long axons, while their axons are short in the sympathetic system (making option opb incorrect). Postganglionic fibers in the parasympathetic system release acetylcholine, not noradrenaline (thus, option opc is incorrect). Postganglionic neurons do have muscarinic receptors, which respond to acetylcholine (making option opd correct). Lastly, the parasympathetic system does not innervate vascular smooth muscle; this is primarily the role of the sympathetic system (thus, option ope is incorrect). Therefore, the best-supported option is opd.
